name: Randon One Block
author: PsyCrow1976
tagline: Experimental AI-built NeoForge skyblock — random center block, FTB quests, milestones, Randon Atlas
pitch: 100% AI-assisted modpack experiment on Minecraft 26.1.2 (1.1.0.1). Core loop: mine one skyblock center block, get a random pack block back. Randon Atlas: unique center rolls tracked per team, curated endgame set, FTB The Atlas chapter (66 pages, 10 XP), /randomblock atlas commands, Atlas Seal on completion. Mine milestones (Utility @ 500, choice @ 1k/5k, Easy Ore Gen @ 2500) and quest-gated minable pools. Equivox Philosopher’s Stone crash fixed (Yaskulsky/Equivox#5 → Equivox 26.1.2-1.3.7). NeoForge 26.1.2.109. The Echo places once at 100,000 team mines; The Randon Ending needs the Atlas Seal and the Echo Seal. Light Level Overlay (F7) marks mob spawn blocks.

inspiration.name: Chaos OneBlock
inspiration.credit: Random one-block re-roll concept — shout-out to the Chaos OneBlock creator
